error.core.canceled: The operation was canceled before it finished.
error.core.conflict: {what} was changed by someone else. Reload it and try again.
error.core.immutable: This field can't be changed after it's created.
error.core.internal: Something went wrong on the server. The details are in the server log.
error.core.invalid: Some values aren't valid. Fix the highlighted fields and try again.
error.core.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait {retryAfter, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} and try again.
error.core.timeout: {what} took too long and was stopped.
error.core.too_large: The request is larger than the {limit} limit.
error.core.unavailable: {what} isn't available right now. Try again in a moment.
error.account.not_empty: The account still has {what}. Delete them first.
error.account.own_scope: An account belongs to itself: give it the same ID in id and in scope, or leave both out and use the open operation.
error.account.slug_reserved: {slug} is the name of a system user, so an account can't use it.
error.account.slug_taken: {value} is already the short name of another account.
error.addons.admin_approval: Only a server admin can approve {permission} for {addon}.
error.addons.bad_token: The request doesn't carry the token of a running add-on.
error.addons.manifest: The add-on's manifest can't be used: {reason}.
error.addons.safe_mode: Safe mode is on, so no add-on runs: {reason}
error.addons.tenancy: {addon} can't be installed for an account: {reason}.
error.addons.unreachable: {addon} didn't answer. It may be starting, stopped or in safe mode.
error.agent.conflict: The {op} operation conflicts with the machine's state: {reason}.
error.agent.invalid_input: The {op} operation was given invalid input: {reason}.
error.agent.not_allowed: The {op} operation isn't allowed to touch {target}.
error.agent.not_found: The {op} operation couldn't find what it needs: {reason}.
error.agent.unknown_operation: The agent has no operation called {op}.
error.api.address_not_allowed: The panel doesn't accept requests from {address}.
error.api.no_sign_in: This panel has no way to sign anyone in yet, so it refuses requests that need a signed-in user.
error.auth.address_not_allowed: Signing in from {address} isn't allowed for {what}.
error.auth.allowlist_locks_out: The allowlist leaves out {address}, where you're connected from, so it would lock you out. Add it first.
error.auth.bad_code: That code isn't right, or it was used already.
error.auth.bad_credentials: The username or password isn't right.
error.auth.bad_setup_code: The setup code isn't right. It's in the panel's log and on the server's console.
error.auth.cannot_impersonate: You can't view the panel as {user}: {reason}.
error.auth.challenge_expired: The sign-in took too long. Start again.
error.auth.cross_site: The request came from another site, so it was refused.
error.auth.disabled: This user is turned off. Ask an admin to turn it back on.
error.auth.grant_not_allowed: You can't give the {role} role on {scope}, because you don't have all of its permissions there yourself.
error.auth.identity_taken: That {provider} account already signs in as another user of this panel.
error.auth.identity_unlinked: Your {provider} account isn't linked to a user of this panel. Sign in another way and link it in your security settings, or ask an admin.
error.auth.impersonating: You're viewing the panel as {user}. Stop viewing as them to {action}.
error.auth.invite_invalid: This sign-in link isn't valid any more. Ask for a new one.
error.auth.last_admin: {user} is the last admin who can sign in. Make someone else an admin first.
error.auth.last_sign_in_method: This is your only way to sign in. Add a password or another passkey first.
error.auth.link_by_hand: Your {provider} account matches a user who manages the whole server, and those link their outside accounts themselves. Sign in another way and link it in your security settings.
error.auth.locked: Too many failed sign-ins for this user. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}, or sign in with a passkey.
error.auth.not_impersonating: You aren't viewing the panel as someone else.
error.auth.own_password: Change your own password in your security settings, where your current one is asked for.
error.auth.panel_only: Only you, signed in to the panel, can do this: API tokens can't change how you sign in. Do it in the panel instead.
error.auth.passkey_unknown: This passkey isn't registered here. Sign in another way and add it in your security settings.
error.auth.passkeys_unavailable: Passkeys work when the panel is opened at its name, such as {hostname}, rather than at an address.
error.auth.password_change_required: Choose a new password to continue.
error.auth.pending: Waiting for you to approve the sign-in.
error.auth.self_delete: You can't delete or turn off yourself. Ask another admin to do it.
error.auth.session_expired: Your session ended. Sign in again.
error.auth.setup_done: This panel already has an admin. Sign in instead.
error.auth.ssh_key_exists: This key is already on the list, as {name}.
error.auth.ssh_key_invalid: This isn't an SSH public key Racksail accepts: {reason}.
error.auth.step_up_required: Confirm it's you to continue: enter your password or a code from your authenticator app, or use a passkey.
error.auth.step_up_unavailable: This needs you to confirm it's you, which an API token can't do. Do it in the panel instead.
error.auth.token_invalid: The API token isn't valid: it was revoked, it expired or it was mistyped.
error.auth.too_many: You have {count} {what} already, which is as many as you can have. Remove one first.
error.auth.totp_exists: An authenticator app is already set up. Remove it first to set up another.
error.auth.totp_not_started: Start setting up an authenticator app first.
error.auth.two_factor_required: Set up a second sign-in step, an authenticator app or a passkey, to continue. Your role needs one.
error.changeset.action_not_repeated: {title} stopped while running {action}, which a retry doesn't run a second time. Run {action} again instead.
error.changeset.bad_contribution: {source} added a change hooks can't add: {reason}.
error.changeset.conflicts: The change has {count} conflicting contributions from hooks. Resolve them before applying it.
error.changeset.contribution_denied: {source} added a change you aren't allowed to make: {reason}
error.changeset.duplicate_request: A request with the same Idempotency-Key is still being processed. Try again in a moment.
error.changeset.empty: The request doesn't ask for any changes.
error.changeset.hook_tampered: A hook changed {what}, which hooks can't change, so the change was stopped.
error.changeset.not_applied: Only applied changes can be undone.
error.changeset.not_preview: {title} isn't a preview, so it can't be applied again.
error.changeset.not_retryable: Only a change that failed can be carried out again, and {title} is {state}.
error.changeset.nothing_to_undo: {title} can't be undone because it didn't change any settings.
error.changeset.preview_has_secrets: {title} carried secret values, which previews don't keep. Send the change again to apply it.
error.changeset.preview_stale: {title} would now do something other than its preview showed. Look at the new preview, {preview}, and apply that instead.
error.changeset.snapshot_failed: The snapshot taken before {title} failed, so nothing was changed: {reason}
error.changeset.still_removing: {what} is still being removed. Try again when the removal has finished.
error.hooks.config_check: The configuration {hook} patched doesn't pass {service}'s own check: {reason}.
error.hooks.failed: {hook} didn't answer in time or failed, and it blocks changes when that happens.
error.hooks.invariant: {hook} tried to loosen {setting}, which only a hook with core.override may do.
error.hooks.overstep: The hook changed {what}, which hooks can't change.
error.hooks.rolled_back: {service} didn't work with the new configuration, so the previous one was put back: {reason}.
error.hooks.unknown_point: There is no hook point called {point}.
error.jobs.already_retried: This job was retried already, as {job}. If that one failed too, retry it instead.
error.jobs.interrupted: The panel stopped while this job was running. Retry it to run it again.
error.jobs.not_retryable: Only failed or canceled jobs can be retried.
error.jobs.unknown_type: There is no job type called {type}.
error.modules.busy: {module} is already being turned on or off. Try again when that has finished.
error.modules.created_by_system: Modules come with Racksail; the panel adds them itself.
error.modules.has_resources: {module} still has {count} resources, and it can't keep them while it is off. Delete them first, or remove the module with its data.
error.modules.in_use: {module} can't be turned off while {dependents} need it.
error.modules.not_deletable: Modules come with Racksail and can't be deleted. Turn {module} off or remove it instead.
error.modules.not_ready: The panel is still setting up {module}. Try again in a moment.
error.modules.nothing_to_turn_on: Every module of the {profile} profile that can run here is already on.
error.modules.off: {module} is off. Turn it on first.
error.modules.opt_in: {software} is only installed when an admin allows it in {module}'s settings.
error.modules.remove_resources: Removing {module} deletes its {count} resources. Remove it with its data, or keep the data.
error.modules.required: {module} is required and can't be turned off.
error.notify.no_relay: Email can't be sent until an admin sets up the mail relay in the notification settings.
error.notify.not_a_person: Notification preferences belong to people. Sign in with your own user to set yours.
error.notify.not_your_preferences: Notification preferences belong to their person, who alone changes them.
error.notify.unknown_channel_type: There is no channel type or notifier called {type}.
error.notify.unknown_type: There is no notification channel type called {type}.
error.recipes.broken: {name} is marked broken in its catalog: {reason}.
error.recipes.file_mismatch: {file} from the {catalog} catalog doesn't match its index.
error.recipes.foreign_resource: {name} lists {resource}, which isn't one of its own resources. An installation only lists what it created where it is installed.
error.recipes.license_notice: {name} isn't open source: it is {class}, under {license}. Accept its license to install it.
error.recipes.marketplace_off: Catalogs are only fetched while the marketplace module is on.
error.recipes.missing_input: The recipe needs a value for {input}.
error.recipes.module_off: {name} needs the {module} module. Turn it on first.
error.recipes.no_source: Name a catalog or a module to install from.
error.recipes.no_upgrade: {name} {version} is the newest version its catalog offers.
error.recipes.not_addon: {item} in the {catalog} catalog isn't an add-on.
error.recipes.not_from_source: {name} doesn't match what {source} offers: {reason}. Install, upgrade and uninstall it from its catalog or module.
error.recipes.not_synced: The {catalog} catalog hasn't been fetched yet.
error.recipes.older_index: The {catalog} catalog served an index older than the one the panel has, so it was refused.
error.recipes.scope: Install into an account or onto the server.
error.recipes.unknown_reference: The recipe refers to {ref}, which it doesn't define.
error.secrets.bad_ref: {ref} isn't a secret reference; use the owner's id, a slash and the secret's name.
error.store.id_used: {id} belonged to a resource that was deleted, so a new resource can't use it. Leave the ID out to get a new one.
error.updates.dev_build: This is a development build, which doesn't update itself.
error.updates.nothing_to_install: There is no newer release to install. Check for updates first.
error.updates.os_upgrade: Debian can't be upgraded from {from} to {to}: {reason}.
error.updates.restarting: Racksail is restarting onto a new release. Try again in a few minutes.
error.updates.stale_check: The last check found {found}, not {version}. Check for updates again.
error.webhook.no_secret: Give the webhook a signing secret, so receivers can check that events come from this server.
event.core.hook.disabled: A hook failed too many times in a row and was switched off.
